results: desktop opens an actual README preview with project/read-only metadata and no recursive directory scan
folder expansion is lazy, preserves root siblings and rejects a returned self-cycle
a directory failure preserves the existing tree and retries only the requested branch
collapse keeps the selected preview and searching explicitly uses the already loaded catalogue
phone opens the full-screen tree first, switches preview explicitly, and keeps the read-only footer visible
file browsing keeps the conversation draft, never invokes a model and has no JavaScript errors
